## Step 8: Prove the workforce is reusable

This is the step that matters most: prove your workforce **generalizes**, not just that it can finish one ticket.

1. Point your assembled workforce (context library, adopted skill, mock integration, proactive agent, parallel coding+testing pair, maintenance graph) at the [`Favorites feature request`](../ISSUE_TEMPLATE/favorites-feature-request.md)-style ticket in this repo.
2. Let it produce a pull request end-to-end.
3. Comment `Favorites PR: #<number>` on this issue once that PR is open and linked back here.
4. In the same comment (or a follow-up), note which pillars needed **zero changes** to work on this new ticket, and which needed a small tweak.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Finishing the Favorites feature isn't the goal — the PR existing is just the evidence. The reuse note is what proves the pattern works.
